continuity.requirement: The accepted candidate is a recoverable successor of the deployed identity; rollback identity remains named; no silent substitution of latest main or development.

provenance.requirement: Source commit/tree, image digest, hash-locked requirements-dev.lock, and supply-chain/SBOM or equivalent named artifacts are inspectable.

reproducibility.requirement: The attested interpreter and hash-locked public-PyPI install can be re-identified for this source identity; an unpinned compiler must not silently replace the lock.
reproducibility.admittedWorkerNote: This framework run used CPython 3.12.3 and python -m pip install --require-hashes -r requirements-dev.lock. That records worker toolchain only; it is not ED-08/ED-09 runtime proof.

rollback.requirement: Prior image, compose projection, channel pointers, and consumer-disable path remain recoverable; ED-08 rollback rehearsal or equivalent receipt exists at the compatible identity.
